Question_text: LEK owns 80 electrical shops. It sells products such as cell (mobile) phones and televisions. The Marketing Director believes offering customers a choice of products helps LEK to be competitive. LEK must use suitable ways to communicate with its customers. LEK's directors are planning a takeover of a competitor. This competitor owns 40 shops and operates in the same 4 regions as LEK.
image: Organizational chart for LEK, titled 'Fig. 1: LEK organisational chart'. It shows a hierarchical structure starting with a 'Managing Director' at the top. Below the Managing Director, there are four functional directors: 'HR Director', 'Finance Director', 'Operations Director', and 'Marketing Director'. Below each of these, there are 'Region 1 Manager', 'Region 2 Manager', 'Region 3 Manager', and 'Region 4 Manager', implying that each director oversees managers in each region. Finally, under each 'Region Manager', there are 'Shop Managers x20', indicating 20 shop managers per region.
Sub_topic: Hierarchical structures: levels, span of control, chain of command, chain of tall/short

Parts.part_text: What is meant by ‘span of control'?
Identify two factors (other than offering choice and having good communication) which could help make LEK more competitive.
Identify and explain two benefits to LEK of having an organisational chart.
Identify and explain two suitable methods of communication that LEK could use to communicate with its customers.
Do you think that the takeover of the competitor would benefit LEK? Justify your answer.

Question_text: Cutter is a family owned private limited company. It manufactures a luxury brand of coats. In 2013 sales revenue increased by $3m and retained profits also increased. ‘The marketing mix is working' said the Marketing Director. Cutter's Operations Director thinks that batch production is still the right method of production to use, but he cannot decide whether on the job or off the job training is better for the business.
Sub_topic: Features: sole traders, partnerships, private/public limited companies, franchises, joint ventures

Parts.part_text: What is meant by 'retained profit'?
Identify two possible advantages to Cutter of being a private limited company.
Identify and explain two possible advantages to Cutter of using batch production.
Identify and explain two possible elements of a suitable marketing mix for Cutter's products.
Do you think it is better for Cutter to use on the job or off the job training? Justify your answer.

Question_text: SENG manufactures cameras. Last year its market share increased by 2% to 18%. Production is capital intensive. This allows SENG to use lean production methods such as just-in-time. Cameras have a short product life cycle. SENG spends $200m each year on extension strategies. The Marketing manager thinks that an increase in market share will lead to higher profits.
Sub_topic: Increasing efficiency: automation, technology, labour skills

Parts.part_text: What is meant by 'capital intensive?'
Identify two possible reasons why cameras might have a short product life cycle.
Identify and explain two possible advantages to SENG of using lean production.
Identify and explain two possible extension strategies that SENG could use for one of its types of camera.
Do you think that an increase in market share will always lead to higher profits for SENG? Justify your answer.

Question_text: The Government of country B plans to build a new airport. A Government spokesperson said: 'There will be external costs, but I think there will be more benefits for the local community. We have to support businesses such as airlines in the private sector'. RU Air is one of the world's most profitable airlines. RU has announced plans on its website that it will operate flights to and from country B in the future. RU is a public limited company.
Sub_topic: Classify private sector, public sector in mixed economy

Parts.part_text: What is meant by the ‘private sector'?
Identify two ways the Government might support RU Air and other private sector business activity (other than by building a new airport).
Identify and explain two benefits to RU Air of high profits.
Identify and explain two benefits for RU Air of having a website.
Do you agree that there are likely to be more advantages for the local community from the new airport than disadvantages? Justify your answer.
